title: Local Mapping Without Iterative Closure: Zero-Shot and Input-Output-Only In-Context Graph-XOR Capability Boundaries in Qwen3
author: Aoi Kawasaki

non_code_publication_materials.applies_to: report, TeX source, figure, README, metadata, public result summaries, and release records

publication_boundary: This package is bound to the published Zenodo version DOI. The correction removes an internal project codename from the public export without changing frozen local branch artifacts or scientific results.

reported_result.primary: Correct input-output demonstrations made a two-input XOR mapping behaviorally available in Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, but no correct-demonstration P3 cell met the predeclared score-signal criterion on the frozen ledgers at 4, 16, or 64 demonstrations.

scope_note: This record closes only the tested Qwen3 0.6B-8B zero-shot official non-thinking and bounded input-output-only ICL graph-XOR route. It does not test hidden-state accessibility, thinking mode, fine-tuning, larger or other model families, naturality, causal use, or broader hypotheses about latent global-obstruction representations.
